dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the state of the Fontaine Research Institute?

dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: The Fontaine Research Institute? If you ask me, it's heading in the right direction.

dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: Without that arrogant fool Edwin, everything is in much better order!

dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: It's no exaggeration to say that the Fontaine Research Institute seized the chance to be reborn. We are free of all burdens and attachments and able to fully dedicate ourselves to...
